_doc: Grounded classification of all Atlas Indonesia geos for Gojek+Grab breadth/depth pass

source_grounding.frontier_proof: raja-ampat signature_routes are prose strings, no route_id -> not sealed

bali-indonesia.label: Bali, Nusa & the Gili Islands
bali-indonesia.note: Hero corridor. Bali↔Nusa Penida/Lembongan, Bali↔Gili/Lombok. 9/10 route_ids sealed + economics.

lombok-indonesia.label: Lombok
lombok-indonesia.note: In luxury island chain bucket (Bali↔Gili/Lombok, Lombok↔Komodo). Sealed route_ids + economics.

komodo-flores-indonesia.label: Komodo & Flores (Labuan Bajo)
komodo-flores-indonesia.note: Komodo↔Sumba, Lombok↔Komodo modeled. Marquee dive/expedition. Sealed.

jakarta-indonesia.label: Jakarta & the Thousand Islands
jakarta-indonesia.note: 5 corridors, 3 route_ids. Ancol↔Thousand Islands inner/outer ring. Capital metro super-app core.

riau-islands-indonesia.label: Bintan & the Riau Islands ↔ Singapore
riau-islands-indonesia.note: SG↔Bintan(Lagoi), SG↔Batam cross-border + SG↔Riau resort reach. Sealed route_ids.

singapore.label: Singapore
singapore.note: 16 corridors but only 2 route_ids — 14 SG corridors need route_id mint (existing-market seal gap).

raja-ampat-indonesia.label: Raja Ampat
raja-ampat-indonesia.note: World-marquee Coral Triangle dive luxury. Rich brief, prose-only signature_routes. Grok must mint BPs+corridors+route_ids+economics (Quanta-LR line-hauls Sorong↔Misool/Waigeo + Pioneer II inter-resort mesh).

likupang-north-sulawesi-indonesia.label: Likupang & Bunaken (North Sulawesi)
likupang-north-sulawesi-indonesia.note: Gov super-priority destination + Bunaken diving. Brief rich. Grok mint required.

lake-toba-samosir-indonesia.label: Lake Toba (Samosir)
lake-toba-samosir-indonesia.note: Gov super-priority destination, large caldera lake, consumer+tourism. Brief rich. Grok mint required.

karimunjawa-central-java-indonesia.label: Karimunjawa
karimunjawa-central-java-indonesia.note: Central Java island chain. Brief exists. Footprint dot + roll-up; Grok mint 1-2 representative corridors for line render.

banda-maluku-indonesia.label: Banda Islands (Maluku)
banda-maluku-indonesia.note: Remote Maluku spice/dive frontier. Footprint dot + roll-up; Grok mint node+representative corridor.

derawan-berau-east-kalimantan-indonesia.label: Derawan (Berau, East Kalimantan)
derawan-berau-east-kalimantan-indonesia.note: MISSING from Grab footprint — add to BOTH. Dive frontier. Footprint dot + roll-up; Grok mint.

wakatobi-southeast-sulawesi-indonesia.label: Wakatobi
wakatobi-southeast-sulawesi-indonesia.note: SE Sulawesi marine-park dive frontier. Footprint dot + roll-up; Grok mint.
